text:
alex: Hey team — quick ping on PR #2142: I updated a bunch of proto JSON tags to camelCase to match what frontend expects. CI passed but there's a couple style nits in review. Need one more approval and a quick consensus on whether we standardize JSON tags to camelCase across services.

maya: I lean camelCase for consistency with JS clients. Quick question though — does this change affect any internal Go consumers that expect snake_case?

chris: We already updated the protobuf JSON marshalling path so clients get camelCase keys now. Server-side structs should have camelCase json tags to avoid adhoc mapping layers.

alex: Ok I can comb through and update the remaining structs. Quick decision: do we want a lint rule to enforce JSON tag casing? Maybe add to proto CI job.

sara: Agree on the lint. Also small nit: in svc/user.proto you left "user_id" as a tag in one struct — prefer "userId" to match the rest.

alex: Good catch, I'll fix. Plan to amend and push a small follow-up. Command I'll run: `git commit --amend -s && git push -f`. Should I squash with the original change?

chris: :thumbsup: squash please. And add a tiny unit test asserting JSON key names in `proto/json_test.go` so we don't regress.

alex: Done and pushed (1732104610). CI rerun queued. @maya @chris PTAL for final approval.

ci-bot: Build PR #2142 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

maya: :eyes: LGTM, approving now.

chris: Approved. Thanks — I'll merge once UI shows green.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up issue to add the lint rule + doc note (tracking issue #2180) and mark ownership as eng-proto.
